figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, the deity or benefactor turns away
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সাহায্য চাইলে বলে, ঠাকুর কাত হয়ে গেছে।
এখন ঠাকুর কাত, কেউ সাহায্য করবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: When he asks for help, they say the deity has turned away.
Now even God has forsaken him, no one will help.
note: Idiom implies divine or benevolent rejection in a mocking tone, rooted in Bengali folk expressions
